newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo denies talks to buy Electrolux.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo denies talks to buy Electrolux.

text.p: Daewoo Electronics Co Ltd, a unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, on Wednesday denied it was in talks with Sweden's Wallenberg group to buy a stake in consumer electronics group Electrolux AB.
"It is not true," Daewoo Electronics spokesman Chung Jae-hyun told Reuters.
On Tuesday, French newspaper La Tribune said the Wallenbergs, who control a large chunk of Swedish industries, were said to be in talks with Daewoo.
La Tribune said the Wallenberg family had decided to sell its stake of Electrolux, in which it holds the majority of voting stock.
"The report seems to have stemmed from our scuttled takeover deal of French electronics company Thomson Multimedia," Chung said.
In December France objected to the plan to sell Thomson Multimedia to Daewoo, citing concerns over technology transfers. The French company is a unit of Thomson SA.
